description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (105), removes KO [Raise: 100%], grants [Last Stand], [Dual Blink 1] and [Haste], grants [Awoken Love] to the user

description.name: Last Stand
description.text: If HP reaches 0, prevents [KO] restoring HP for 1% maximum HP, removed after triggering

description.name: Dual Blink 1
description.text: Evades the next attack that could be evaded with [Physical Blink] or [Magical Blink], lower priority than [Physical Blink] and [Magical Blink]

description.name: Awoken Love
description.text: White Magic abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x3.00 for White Magic abilities, casts Wave of Mending after using White Magic abilities
